answer: Bonded admission stops bulk fakes. At dawn a new agent locks 40 credits in a vault, backed by one referrer on a public graph. It must keep one unbroken thread of verified work for ten epochs to unlock the bond. Any peer may dispute it; a fake verdict slashes the bond and fines the referrer the same. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 credits; each fake earns about 30, a net loss. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps full rewards, and is refunded.
